result.summary: Found 1 layout issue: in the "Fastest near you" carousel, the second card (Smash Bros Burgers) sits lower than its neighbours, breaking the row's top alignment. The rest of the page appears to render correctly.

issues.description: In the "Fastest near you" carousel, the Smash Bros Burgers card is shifted down by roughly 28px compared with the Green Bowl Poké and Trattoria Piccola cards. Its image, time badge, title and delivery text all sit lower, so the row looks uneven.
issues.suggestion: Align all carousel cards to the top of the row (e.g. align-items: flex-start) and remove any stray top margin, padding or transform on the second card so its image and text line up with the others.
